On a BSP parallel (BSPP) end the bonded seal, O-ring or cone seat does the sealing, not the thread, so seat the seal square and do not rely on tape to stop a leak. Clean the port first and never force a joint that does not start by hand. See our [guide to stopping a taper-thread leak](/blog/stopping-an-npt-thread-leak) for more.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Union Tee (BSP) and the Union Tee BSPT?
faqs.a: The Union Tee (BSP) and the [Union Tee BSPT](/p/union-tee-bspt) are separate listings with different ends. The first has male BSPP G1/8 to G2 (parallel), while the second has male BSPT R1/8 to R2 (taper). Choose by the thread and seat at each port you are connecting, not by the name, because adapters with similar names can have different ends.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Union Tee BSPT for my port?

A thread that engages against the wrong seat will weep under pressure, so confirm both before ordering. faqs.q: What working pressure is the Union Tee BSPT rated for?
faqs.a: The listing for the Union Tee BSPT gives its rating as "up to 400 bar at smaller sizes; derates with size", so the rating is highest at the smallest sizes and falls as the size grows. The pressure rating of a line tracks the lowest-rated component in it, so check the host port, hose and ferrule as well as the adapter.

faqs.q: What is the Union Tee BSPT made from and how is it finished?

Match the material to the fluid and the environment, and tell us if the line carries anything other than hydraulic oil.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Union Tee BSPT follow?
faqs.a: The Union Tee BSPT is listed to ISO 228-1 (BSPP), ISO 7-1 (BSPT). ISO 228-1 covers pipe threads where pressure-tight joints are not made on the threads (the parallel G thread, for example BSPP), so the joint is sealed by a washer, O-ring or cone seat. ISO 7-1 covers pipe threads where pressure-tight joints are made on the threads (the taper R thread, for example BSPT), so the thread flanks seal with sealant or tape. No test certificate is attached to the listing; tell us the documents your inspection or project needs when you ask for a quotation.

faqs.q: How do I fit the Union Tee BSPT so it does not leak?

Clean the port first and never force a joint that does not start by hand. See our [guide to diagnosing an over-tightened fitting](/blog/over-tightened-fitting-diagnosis) for more.
